cezarReason: Pinned Cezar workflows currently name Codex runners. Only zero-spend mock/synthetic workflows are permitted; no live Cezar route is admitted.

brainstorming.excerpt: Before you start implementing, you must, in order:

writing-plans.excerpt: Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified

test-driven-development.excerpt: NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST

systematic-debugging.excerpt: NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST

requesting-code-review.excerpt: Dispatch a code reviewer subagent to catch issues before they cascade.

verification-before-completion.excerpt: NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE

ai:discovery.method: Define the user problem, evidence vs assumptions, target user, measurable outcome, viable alternatives (including no change), prioritized scope, non-goals, and negative journeys. Resolve only delegated routine decisions. No invented evidence or implementation.

ai:plan.method: Compare architectures, confirm real paths and dependencies, produce an ADR, explicit interface/data/auth/invariants, failure recovery and reversible rollback, executable test plan, and open gates. No code until prerequisites.

ai:lane-a.method: Create a dependency DAG with ready-only tasks, exclusive file/interface/data ownership, bounded context and budget, exact handoffs; no dispatch before required gates. Demonstrate overlap only for truly independent work.

ai:lane-b.method: Coordinate alongside Lane A with independent owned work and overlap; serialize shared changes. Specify idempotent interruption/recovery, stale-checkpoint and duplicate-dispatch tests; no static-only go.

ai:design.method: Map the user journey and responsive accessible screens. Include empty/loading/error/permission/offline states, validation and destructive-action recovery. Keep exact contract labels, flag and unresolved gates.

ai:database.method: Map actual schema and authorized scope before proposing changes. Specify tenant partition, expected-revision conflict, idempotency, immutable snapshots, negative controls, reversible migration or no migration. Never apply live SQL.

ai:integration.method: Verify exact service boundaries, typed inputs/outputs, auth, local vs external transport, timeouts/retries/429/malformed responses and idempotency. Name actual test runner; do not invent API or claim readiness.

ai:tests.method: Map every locked acceptance case to testable behavior, negative controls, intended RED, independent clean/mutant calibration and guard tests; never implement product or self-approve.

ai:tests-review.method: Challenge exact author artifact against every acceptance requirement with line evidence, mutation and false-positive risks; reject missing mandatory proof. Different model family; do not edit tests.

ai:tests-signoff.method: Verify exact locked artifacts, independent challenger, intended RED, clean/mutant and runtime eligibility. Reject any failed or missing gate; no override.

ai:build.method: Prove existing locked tests fail for intended reason, smallest authorized change, fresh GREEN/regression/negative controls, exact diff; do not weaken tests or expand scope.

ai:fix.method: Reproduce root cause, isolate one hypothesis, preserve failure receipt, add/reuse a failing regression test, fix narrowly, verify fresh results; no repeated blind retries.

ai:qa.method: Independently execute actual acceptance, regression and security negative cases on exact candidate. Record failures and missing evidence; never accept author self-report.

ai:review.method: Inspect exact diff and locked contract, attack edge cases, forbidden changes, security and weak tests. Cite reproducible evidence. Reject missing gates, never review own work.

ai:release-ops.method: Confirm exact revision, independent approval, CI and smoke; verify authorized preview, disable/rollback and health. Distinguish build from deploy/release; no production authority.
